command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj RV-P5-jal-jtype.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one line each (LF, trailing newline): `jal ra, 8` / `addi a0, a1, 1` / `jal ra, -8`. `ra` is x1. The two calls are PC-relative at offsets 0 and 8, so the second targets offset 0. The plan states the same bytes through two `scale` fixups with `transform_shift: 1`; both are `resolve_in_place`, so no relocation record is emitted and `records` is 0.
